create_scannet_voxelization_dataset: create a ScannetVoxelizationDataset instance with config, transforms, augmentation, and dataset phase for 3D scene segmentation
load_scannet_pointcloud_data: load pointcloud coordinates, features, semantic labels, and instance labels from a ScanNet .pth file by index
augment_pointcloud_location_feature: augment a pointcloud tensor by appending a scaled location feature column at the specified LOCFEAT_IDX position
save_scannet_prediction: save voxel grid predictions mapped back to original pointcloud space as a torch file for ScanNet evaluation submission
get_scannet_output_id: get the room ID string from a data path by extracting the first two underscore-separated segments of the filename
